title: BitBot — College Chatbot & Admin Panel
shortDescription: A comprehensive college project built during my 5th semester, featuring an intelligent AI chatbot interface with voice support and a powerful admin panel with full CRUD operations for Bhagwant Institute of Technology.
overview: BitBot is a full-featured college management system built during my 5th semester for Bhagwant Institute of Technology (BIT) as an academic project. The project comprises two integrated applications: an intelligent chatbot interface for students and a powerful admin panel for college staff. The chatbot handles student queries about courses, faculty, facilities, admission procedures, fee structures, and academic schedules — using NLP-based response matching with text-to-speech and speech-to-text capabilities. The admin panel provides comprehensive CRUD operations backed by Firebase Firestore.
features: Intelligent chatbot with NLP-based response matching for student queries
Voice support — text-to-speech and speech-to-text capabilities
Multi-language support for diverse student demographics
Real-time typing indicators and animated chat responses
Quick action predefined response buttons for common queries
Multimedia-rich responses with images, links, and formatted content
Admin dashboard with system-wide statistics and recent activity overview
Full CRUD operations for Course, Faculty, Student, and Timetable management
Bulk CSV import/export for efficient course data management
Notice management system — publish and manage college announcements
Fee structure management for multiple courses
Advanced search, filter, and sort capabilities in all data tables
Responsive design working across desktop, tablet, and mobile
Firebase Authentication integration for admin security

architecture.description: The project uses a multi-page HTML architecture split into a public-facing chatbot interface and a protected admin panel. Firebase Firestore serves as the backend-as-a-service (BaaS) for real-time data persistence. The admin panel communicates with Firebase via the SDK for all CRUD operations.

collections: courses — course details, affiliation, duration, fees, HOD

myRole: Sole Developer. Designed and built the complete chatbot interface and admin panel — including Firebase integration, all CRUD operations, data table configuration with Tabulator.js, and the NLP-based chatbot response system.
challenges: Building a context-aware chatbot without a traditional AI API — relying on pattern matching and keyword detection for intelligent response generation
Implementing bulk CSV import/export for course data with proper validation, error handling, and user feedback
Integrating Firebase Firestore in real-time for admin panel operations with proper loading states and optimistic UI updates
Designing a dual-interface system (public chatbot + protected admin) with a consistent visual language but distinct user experiences
Configuring Tabulator.js for complex, sortable, filterable data tables with custom cell renderers
solutions: Built a keyword-based intent recognition system that maps user query patterns to predefined response templates, with fallback responses for unrecognized queries
Implemented CSV parsing with FileReader API and row-by-row Firebase batch write operations, with progress indicators and validation error reporting
Used Firebase's real-time listeners (onSnapshot) for dashboard statistics and Firestore's promise-based API for CRUD operations with proper async/await error handling
Created separate CSS namespaces for chatbot and admin styles, sharing only design tokens (colors, fonts, spacing) via CSS custom properties
Configured Tabulator with custom formatters, sorters, and editors to handle Firebase-style data structures with nested fields
keyLearnings: Firebase Firestore integration — real-time listeners, batch operations, and structuring NoSQL data for a college management use case
Building an NLP-lite chatbot using keyword matching and pattern detection without external AI APIs
Advanced Tabulator.js configuration for production-ready data tables with custom rendering
Implementing voice input/output (Web Speech API) for chatbot accessibility
Designing admin panels with complex CRUD workflows and data visualization
